notes.title: Small Patch 2.4
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you for your patience while I took some time to rest and work on optimization and minor bug fixes. I am now planning and developing a larger update for Hachishaku which I plan to launch in October probably. I hope to add the 'Chado's Nightmare' mode with new costumes and lots of adjustments. Then I will begin work on the next game! I am taking some time to decide the waifu that will chase us due to Steam's new rules. I am concerned about using Hanako-san due to these rules even though I plan to make her an adult the height may cause issues. So I will change the plan and announce it soon on twitter/X, so make sure you are following me there!

- Fixed a bug where the jizo could be dropped in certain locations and no longer picked up
- Updated game to UE 5.6 for better performance
- Improved overall optimization and stability.
- fixed a bug on the goth outfit where her torso would sometimes disappear
- blocked the "Call" ability while in hiding spots
- added infinite stamina to gravure mode

notes.title: Patch and small update in progress!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Everyone! Thank you for a successful Steam Summer Sale! I really appreciate your support and hope you are all enjoying Hachishaku! 

I am working hard on the content for the major update coming later this summer. While making Hachishaku I was working constantly, which worried my wife a bit. So I've decided that for my health I would take things a bit slower this time and make sure to not overwhelm myself again. I am a solo developer, so there is a lot that I have to do on my own. 

I've also decided to replace my very weak PC with one that I can develop properly on, which I plan to get later next month, So right now I am focused on bug fixes, optimization, and new costumes. The new mode I have the core idea for and will start developing it next month once the new PC arrives!

I've posted it on twitter, but here is a tease of the bunny costume which I finished modeling recently!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545970/81795034559906a698ec5ad119d34da8b2227b9a.jpg"][/img]

I also am working on a cow themed outfit, some more hats, and maybe some recolors. I have several more I will make for the big update with the new mode though. 

Beyond that I also want to be able to put a lot of focus on my next game soon. I will really need to find an animator who can help. I am speaking to some people right now, but if you are an animator who has worked in Unreal Engine before please reach out on X/twitter right away! 

I apologize that there has not been a patch or content update this month, I was very exhausted and wanted to spend time resting and working slowly and carefully. so I am doing my best! Thank you for your patience![/p]

notes.title: Reupload Patch V2.01.2
notes.content:
I apologize for the issue with the previous patch. I can confirm it must have been an issue with the upload to the steam server. I have reuploaded the build and checked it's stability through steam directly this time and it should be properly functioning. I sincerely apologize for disappointing everyone and will make sure to more thoroughly test the next patches. 

I hope you can all enjoy Hachishaku more thoroughly now . Here are the patch notes for v2.1 


Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where Hachishaku would get stuck if trying to move somewhere she can't access, you can now use 'call' to reset her AI. 

- Fixed an issue with the gravure chance achievement. 

Adjustments:
- Calling Hachishaku now interrupts and updates her current target location. As stated above this can also reset her when she is stuck and not moving.  NOTE - This has caused a new bug where sometimes she will become stuck on the gravure chance spot's hitbox after viewing the scene. I am investigating this but wanted to fix the bigger problem as soon as I could. 

- With the exception of the gravure expert achievement, I've further checked the achievement unlocks and confirmed myself on a fresh steam account that they are all working when the final item is collected (photos/notes/gravure chance scenes). To clarify, there are 12 photographs, 22 notes, and 5 gravure chance spots. The code works exactly like the jizo collection, so they must be completed in a single playthrough. Restarting the game or game over resets the count as well. I don't like blaming player error though, so I accept that after this update if the achievement is still not unlocking for players the issue must be tied to save file issues, steam back-end, or something unknown.  I have rebuilt the code from scratch again so it should 100% be working. 

Other: 
- Improved AI behaviors
- made additional optimization fixes

Upcoming Quick Additions and fixes
- Visual indicator for the gravure chance spots and their active trigger bounds. 
- further bug fixes and optimization

notes.title: Gravure Mode Release Date June 13th!
notes.content:
[p]Happy Friday Everyone! 

I want to apologize for not being able to push an update or patch this weekend. I can only work on Hachishaku in the evenings and a little bit during lunch so things are a bit tight. I am working as hard and as fast as I can, I am even waiting until after gravure mode is out to play Elden Ring Nightreign, no down time until the work is done! That said, I really want gravure mode to feel like a proper expansion of content. So I added some extra gameplay elements that I had not originally planned along with some more QOL features. 

This is everything that is coming in the update and is currently being polished and tested out thoroughly: 

[b][u]General Updates for both modes[/u][/b]

- You can now rotate Hachishaku in the costume shop and costume selection menus

- You can also click on Hachishaku in the costume select menu for a special surprise!

- 3 new achievements

- improved AI - I tried to solve some problems like Hachishaku getting stuck sometimes, but have not had much luck with this. However, I was able to make this happen slightly less often! IF anyone has experience developing AI in Unreal Engine please reach out I would love to talk to you! 

[b][u]Gravure mode[/u][/b]

- Lakeside Retreat map - This map is roughly 3/4 the size of the Naninani Mura map and features several points of interest for you and Hana-chan to enjoy together. 

- Gravure Chance spots - Hidden interactions where you must call Hachishaku over to start the interaction. When she arrives a cutscene begins where you can take photos that will save to your game's directory (wherever it is installed to)! These will be very high resolution photos too, so you can enjoy viewing them in the best quality! I've completed 3, the 4th is almost done, and the 5th is laid out and ready for lighting and polish. These are between 30 to 90 seconds each depending on the spot. I still need to come up with a hint for where the spots may be but I don't want it to be super obvious. I want you to consider special places that would be perfect for a gravure shoot. These spots have a ~3 minute cool down, so you can change costumes and do them again! I am trying to make time for a super secret 6th gravure spot but I can't be sure If I will be able to do it. I will try my best! 

- New lore and story to be discovered - Learn about Chado and Hana's life together and their wedding through the wedding photos that have gone missing. Hana scared the post man by accident when he was delivering the photos resulting in them blowing away. Find them all to get more money and see special illustrations. I am trying to make these a one time interaction so that when you find them they will display in Chado and Hana's house permanently. 

- Hachishaku's 5 missing hats - Along with the wedding photos being blown away you can also find Hana's hats throughout the map, find them to get more money! (IF I am able to complete everything in time early next week I would like to make these 5 new hats that the player can unlock instead. but I am not sure if I can manage it yet) 

- Hana posing - If you call Hana to any spot that isn't an Gravure spot or interaction she will do a random pose so that you can use the screenshot function with the Q or F12 keys. 

[b][u]Upcoming content after Gravure Mode[/u][/b]

I am a bit tired so after gravure mode is out I will focus on bug fixes and adjustments, but I would like to take some time off to rest and relax a bit so that I can have a fresh mind and body for making more fun stuff! That said I have already started working on the promised additional costumes I won't be able to get into this update dude to time (though I will still try my hardest next week) Here are the things I will get in sometime soon, but I don't want to promise a date or timeframe yet. Maybe a few weeks later. 

- New costume models, i promised 2, but I think I can do more after I rest a bit!
- Additional Hair Styles
- Chado man - Pac man style mini game mode where Chado must avoid 4 different hachishaku's at one time. This will likely unlock a costume and money
- Hachishaku Game - Darumasan ga Koronda style game to unlock costume and money
- Day and night versions for the gravure mode map. (to direct the lighting and visuals best, I will let the player choose the time of day via an interaction instead of a dynamic day/night cycle) 


Again, I am very sorry for not being able to push any patch or update this weekend, but I think the wait will be worth it! With continued support I can add even more content to Hachishaku, and I already have some very fun ideas!

In light of that, I also want to ask if I can get your opinion on starting a patreon. I am very bad at being active on social media stuff because I tend to just work and post things when it's done. But I've seen a lot of indie devs use this method to continue funding projects. Is it something any of you would be interesting in supporting in the future? 

Lastly, I have already decided on the waifu for the next game! Perhaps a secret tease will be added to story mode somewhere? Do your best to think of some of yoru favorite urban legends and female youkai from Japan to find the teaser! I will begin development of this game in Late July and Intend to release it just in time for Halloween. 

Thank you all for supporting Hachishaku! I will continue to do my best to give you lots of fun memories with Hana-chan and Chado![/p]

[/list]

[u][h3]Things I am considering for future updates[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Chado-Man mode - pacman style mini game for collecting money and secret unlocks 
[*] Hachishaku Game - Darumasan ga Koronda style game 
[*] Alternate map for Gravure mode
[*] Day/Night cycle for Gravure mode to add variety 
[*] Hachishakusama Returns! - A mode in a new map where the evil Hachishaku from the past returns to take Chado's soul. Play as Hana-Hachishaku to save Chado-san. (will add new journals and notes to all modes!)
[/list]

Unfortunately there are some features I have tried to figure out but don't think I can add for this game.I will try my hardest, but they are now low priority because I think they are beyond my ability right now, so I don't want to make a promise that it can be done. If I am able to solve these issues I will at some point!

[u]Key Mapping[/u] - It just keeps breaking with my current code and re-working the whole system will take too much work to fix right now. I will 100% solve this for the next game. If I am able to figure out 

[u]Hachishaku entering buildings[/u] - I've come up with a method that could work, but it will take a little more time to get it working consistently enough that Hachishaku doesn't get stuck inside anywhere. For Now I will consider this as a "maybe in the future". The good news is that In any future game This issue is definitely solved from day 1. The main issue is how big Hachishaku is and how narrow the hallways inside are. So these buildings are just not suited for a giant waifu. Right now she gets stuck in interaction loops if she is too close to other doors.

[b]Thank you all for your support so far! I hope you have been enjoying your time with Hana-chan and Chado-san! Gravure mode should be out next weekend and I am working as hard as I can to fill it with lots of fun content and romance![/b]

notes.title: Update Costume Considerations
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As described above, I wanted to share concept art of the next costumes I am considering. I would like your opinions before I start modeling, so that I can deliver content you want to see most!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545970/c61af4ec0ee18f937d2cac27df954b0eb0fc5414.jpg[/img]

The first 3 additions I am considering are; 

- A new swimsuit (hopefully with the braids hairstyle but this is difficult to model for me, and if it can't be animated then maybe it's not worth it?) 

- a special waitress costume! If you are familiar with Variable Geo or the restuarant Pomu no Ki you may recognize it's style. 

- A shrine maiden costume which is very proper for our Hana-chan's pure heart. 

I would love to know which you like most and would also like to know what your desired costumes are! Please don't be shy about requests. Though, I do not plan to add any nude costumes! 

[b][u]Some other things I am considering for a patch I hope to complete this weekend are; [/u][/b]

- Several alternate hair colors for the current hair styles
- additional alternate colors for the current models, to celebrate the Chinese localization I will also make a special recolor for one of the dresses that will have lots of Chinese flair! 


I am not sure which things will get done for this weekend because improvements and bug fixes must come first. Unfortunately my time during the week is very limited due to my daily work, and this weekend is mother's day, so I won't have enough time to achieve much. I'm sorry that I may be moving too slowly. 

[b][u]Gravure mode Update[/u][/b]

- I am working hard on the Gravure mode update when possible! It will have a unique map, Hachishaku will be non-hostile allowing you to observe her doing cute things and take screenshots at your leisure! I am considering making some special activities that cost money to purchase in order to increase the gameplay 
- I would like to add at least 2 new costumes, 2 new hair styles, and however many hats and accessories I can make in time. 
- I will add a function called "call" that allows the player to yell for Hachishaku to come over. This will also work in the main game as a distraction method! 
- I can't animate very well myself so I am looking for nice animations to use so that I can add plenty of cute things for hachishaku to do. If anyone is an animator and would like to get in contact, please reach out to me on X/twitter!  [url=https://x.com/TRPandaGames]https://x.com/TRPandaGames[/url]

[b][u]Bug Fixes and Various additions[/u][/b]

I will be fixing and adding the following things as soon as possible! I am doing my best to address every bug and push updates when I feel like enough was done to be worth updating your game. 
My computer is not very good and it can take several hours to make the build in unreal engine, so I have to be a bit careful with timing. I would really like to get a new computer if Hachishaku continues to do well! 

- Super melon bomb (can you guess what this would do?)
- Small fruit bomb (for the people whose taste is a bit smaller) 
- Smoke bomb switcher function
- Improve the interaction system's stability
- improve the dialogue system's stability
- Improve the functionality of the map. 
- improve the safety of dropping the jizo so that it doesn't become stuck anywhere. 

I don't know how long it will take to add these or fix these bugs but I am working on them whenever I can! If you know of other bugs please keep posting them in the bug report thread and I will respond there ASAP! 

I would also like to improve the general quality of Hachishaku's model in the future, but maybe it is too big of a goal for now haha. In order to add more options for "growth" I would need to remake it and all the costumes, so I think I would want to be able to hire someone with more skill and experience to do it properly. If the game can sell enough copies for me to do that than I will right away! For now I hope that I can continue to bring joy with the Hachishaku I made myself! 

Thank you to everyone who has purchased Hachishaku! I hope our Hana-chan is helping you enjoy your visit to Naninanimura!

notes.title: Emergency Hotfix!
notes.content:
I've imporved the stability of interactions based on some feedback and investigation. 

I am not sure what is causing the issue for sure, but I have taken some extra measures to prevent overlapping interactions which could cause the game to break. If I figure out what is causing it specifically I will push a patch right away of course. 

HOWEVER! I have also added the ability to escape from dialogue (even potential phantom dialogue) by pressing backspace/cancel (right face button on gamepad). So if the game locks up try pressing backspace! 

I have also made the interact more precise in TPS view, so you need to make sure that the crosshair is actually over the interactable item, hopefully that also helps the issue.

I've also also gone through and made sure that interactions are functioning properly by spamming my mouse key on everything from every angle for a few hours. It all SHOULD be working, but I will do my best to fix it more tomorrow if not. 

Thank you all for supporting the game! I will make sure that you can enjoy it more properly this weekend!

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes and Gamma slider added
notes.content:
Apparently I have night vision, as expected of a solo racoon developer. Many players reached out to say the game was too dark, so I added a gamma slider to the in game pause settings! I hope this improves your experience!

I've also fixed some items that were difficult to interact with! 

I will patiently wait a bit longer today for more feedback unless it's a huge problem that needs to be fixed! Sorry for pushing 2 quick patches in 4 hours!

notes.title: Steam Approves!
notes.content: Steam just came through and gave me the greenlight! Hachishaku will be out tomorrow morning at 8am EST!

notes.title: Waiting on Steam for release...
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

Hachishaku is tested, complete, and ready for launch. However, even though I submitted my first build a few weeks ago it got denied due to an issue with UE5.4 games crashing if the player doesn't force DX11 at launch. 

I've fixed that issue and resubmitted the build last week. However, Steam still has not approved the build or even updated me on progress for the review. It's over the 3-5 day review period now and It doesn't look like Steam will be approving it in time to release tomorrow. Im very frustrated by this, but there is nothing I can do. As soon as Steam approves my build I will schedule a new launch for the following thursday or friday. Until then I will keep testing and polishing more and more. I am sorry for not being able to put the game out on the original date. Next time I will make sure to have a build approved far in advance just in case... 

- Trash Panda
